title: The Superior Nature of Christ
english: If all created nature worships Christ—for through the angels' designation he signifies a nature superior in reason, just as it was once said in some [passage] concerning the angels: 'Sit at my right hand' (Ps 110:1); and he is above this—and the scriptures speak of worship through creation, not looking up,  saying, 'looking into heaven, and seeing the sun and the moon and the stars and all the cosmos of heaven, having gone astray, you will worship them' (Jer 51:41). Since worshiping these is forbidden, so also for the other creatures, even if any should happen to be highly ascended. As has been said before, it is fitting to be confirmed that it is not a creature but the Creator who is Christ, even if through us he united to himself the created flesh having received a rational and spiritual soul, and thus he is worshiped as God by all the creation (Heb 1:6).
To all belongs time, and an opportune time to every single thing under the heaven.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
